response.rationale: These are two different concepts. A is the hive owner, the person or account that owns a hive. TreatmentService (src/business/treatmentService.ts) checks ownership with `if (hive.ownerId !== ownerId) {`, which treats the owner as an attribute of a hive that points to someone else. B is the Hive itself, the beehive used as a lookup key in HarvestRepository.findByHive (src/persistence/repositories.ts): `findByHive(hiveId: string): Harvest[] {`. The hive and its owner are linked, but one is a beehive and the other is a person or account, so they are not the same real-world thing.
